categories.name: Specification

categories.name: Management
categories.description: Project issues, knowhow precipitation, and knowledge-store management — /maestro-issue, /maestro-knowhow, /maestro-knowledge

categories.name: Team Skills
categories.description: Multi-agent team collaboration skills for orchestrated parallel workflows

categories.name: Odyssey
categories.description: Long-running iterative cycles — one entry, five modes (debug|improve|planex|review|ui)

categories.name: Learning
categories.description: Guided reading, investigation, pattern extraction, and second opinions — unified /maestro-learn command

categories.name: Wiki
categories.description: Knowledge graph management, connection discovery, and digest generation

categories.name: Scholar Skills
categories.description: Academic writing & research skills — paper writing, citation verification, experiment analysis, and rebuttal

categories.name: Meta Skills
categories.description: Skill tooling and prompt engineering — create, simplify, tune skills, generate prompts, and check delegation contracts

commands.name: maestro
commands.description: Auto-route intent to optimal command chain — default multi-step closed-loop orchestration; stepwise interactive execution via /maestro-next

commands.name: maestro-init
commands.description: Initialize project with auto state detection — creates .workflow/ directory structure

commands.name: maestro-ralph
commands.description: Closed-loop policy over the canonical Session/Run chain — dispatch run-executor, evaluate decisions, retry, and stop

commands.name: maestro-next
commands.description: Default interactive entry for development intents — recommend and execute one atomic step; multi-step work builds a user-confirmed manual-engine chain, walks stepwise, or hands off to /maestro

commands.name: maestro-companion
commands.description: Quick execution for small tasks — minimal Run lifecycle with direct execution and evidence recording

commands.name: maestro-impeccable
commands.description: Frontend UI design, audit, polish, and codification — build, redesign, improve, enhance, launch, harden

commands.name: maestro-overlay
commands.description: Create or edit command overlays from natural language, or auto-generate from workflow deficiency signals

commands.name: maestro-fork
commands.description: Create or sync session worktree for parallel development

commands.name: maestro-merge
commands.description: Merge session worktree branch back to main

commands.name: maestro-guard
commands.description: Manage editing boundary restrictions — directory-level write boundaries

commands.name: maestro-session-seal
commands.description: Seal current session with knowledge extraction and DAG progression

commands.name: maestro-update
commands.description: Detect version, preview changes, apply workflow upgrades

commands.name: maestro-spec
commands.description: Intent-driven spec precipitation — state a constraint in natural language and the workflow infers the category and records a <spec-entry>. Records only: loading is `maestro spec load`, removal is the `specs-remove` step.
commands.argumentHint: [intent — e.g. '加一条规范：禁止用 any' | 'arch 约束：服务间走 gRPC' | '--scope team coding: 统一用 pnpm']

commands.name: maestro-issue
commands.description: Intent-driven issue lifecycle — report, list, close, link, or discover issues in .workflow/issues/
commands.argumentHint: <intent — e.g. 'report a login bug' | 'list open' | 'close ISS-xxx' | 'discover'>

commands.name: maestro-knowhow
commands.description: Intent-driven knowhow precipitation — record decisions, templates, recipes, and tips into .workflow/knowhow/
commands.argumentHint: <intent — e.g. 'record a JWT refresh decision' | 'template this retry code' | 'tip: redis pitfall'>

commands.name: maestro-knowledge
commands.description: Intent-driven knowledge-store management — audit, harvest, wiki health, knowledge-graph linking, and domain terms
commands.argumentHint: <intent — e.g. 'audit knowledge base' | 'harvest this session' | 'wiki health' | 'register term MVP'>

commands.name: maestro-odyssey
commands.description: Long-running iterative cycle — one entry, six modes. Shared archaeology/audit → fix → verify → generalize → discover → persist.

commands.name: maestro-learn
commands.description: User-invoked learning toolkit — guided reading, investigation, pattern extraction, or second opinions. Manual /maestro-learn only; auto code analysis routes via /maestro-next.
